headline: YOUR LAPS lands; the hard-setting corpus is baked
lede: Slot b resumed a half-shipped Excitebike feature, drove it through independent verification and the nightly gate to production, then opened stage 3d on the research board: the export tool finally speaks the hard difficulty stamp, and a verified imitation corpus at that stamp is already on disk. Two builders on one slot proved the handoff works — a sibling lane squashed while this one verified.

notes.text: EXCITEBIKE YOUR LAPS live (32f4556, #2625 stage 1): the bay grows a LAP tool — the designer picks 1..8 laps, the number rides the codec and the splash, the seat honors it; default 2 keeps every saved design byte-identical. Resumed from a dead session's pushed corpse; re-verified excitecheck 385/385 + exciteplay 129/129; prod chunk carries the law.

red main cleared in under an hour: nightly #2626's three failures were harness drift/timing (watch-pin drift, a fletching terrain race, a pixel scan sampling after the plate settled). A parallel lane merged the identical fix; the doomed superseded nightly was cancelled so the fixed tip proved itself ~50 min earlier and the whole merge queue went green.

Plaicraft stage 3d (#2621): held-out 906..929 chosen and written before any model plays it; export gate answered and fixed (PR #2633 merged) — recordings now stamp {slack, wizard} and replay verifies the stamp; full hard corpus baked: 20/20 verified, 370k rows, provenance manifest. Training can start the moment the 3090 lane picks it up.
FLOOR BOSS NO CORNER STACKS + TEACH THE ELBOW (#2627 stages 1–2) shipped from slot a in the same wave — the queue drained while the nightly ran.
